column5: Routed 2026-08-25 at /play/roulette; the worst of the seven - a 1350x810 dialog, the largest in the casino, so 375 resolved to scale 0.264 (Bet 85.5x13.7, chip denominations 8.2x8.2, icon controls 11.6 sq) on the game whose whole interaction is dropping chips on individual numbers.
